record: Static browser workspace developer checks before publication
scope: Synthetic inputs and public queries only. Developer verification on one Windows workstation with WSL Ubuntu, headless Chrome 157, and Node.js 24. Not an independent security review, accessibility qualification, or scientific validation.

python_checks.in_process_runner_equivalence: Result fields other than identifiers and timestamps matched the separate-process runner for a four-row permutation fixture
python_checks.pyodide_under_node: All core modules imported, including ssl; analysis, method review, report, execution, and package actions returned 200

browser_checks.execution: Permutation fixture INDETERMINATE with p = 1/3, matching CPython

live_literature.europepmc: COMPLETED ledger event, 3 records imported for a public synthetic query
live_literature.crossref: COMPLETED ledger event, 3 records imported for a public synthetic query

browser_checks.model_failure_path: Unresolvable synthetic endpoint recorded FAILED with ATTEMPTED transmission and credential_supplied true; the key did not appear in any response
browser_checks.timeout_path: With only the first 37-second timer shortened, a heavy execution returned LOCAL_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT, the worker restarted, and the next execution returned one result
browser_checks.console_errors: Only the expected name-resolution failure of the synthetic model endpoint

retained_observations: The first build failed because lock dependencies use underscores while lock keys use hyphens; names are now normalized.

Start-up first took 57 to 74 seconds in headless Chrome. Timing showed 41 seconds in Pyodide initialization against 1.3 seconds under Node.js. Plain JavaScript and WebAssembly loops ran at matching speed, and hiding JSPI in the worker reduced start-up to about 3 seconds.
The first timeout check shortened every execution timer, so its recovery step also timed out; the check now shortens only the first timer.

The first Pages workflow run at 7445241 failed before publishing: its build step did not install the package that build_distributions.py imports. It now installs the package as the software checks do.
limits: No screen-reader, Firefox, Safari, or mobile-device check.
The live GitHub Pages deployment is recorded separately after publication.
Framing is not prevented because GitHub Pages cannot send headers.

published_deployment.wheel: Digest matched the manifest; 30 package files matched the source
published_deployment.network: About 15 KB/s from this workstation to GitHub Pages; the WebAssembly file arrived gzip-compressed as 3.6 MB in 289 seconds with curl
published_deployment.chrome_start_up: Stalled beyond 25 minutes with QUIC enabled; ready after 484 seconds with QUIC disabled, with no failed request, exception, or console message
published_deployment.failed_start: A later live start reported that the runtime could not start and offered only a reload

start_up_hardening.cause: Pyodide logged that WebAssembly instantiation failed and then waited indefinitely when its WebAssembly download was refused
start_up_hardening.change: The worker downloads and checks every runtime file before Pyodide starts, retries interrupted downloads, bounds the remaining start-up at 120 seconds, and the page retries a failed start twice
start_up_hardening.refused_manifest_once: Retried by the page with a retry message; ready
start_up_hardening.full_local_workflow: Passed at 390 and 1440 pixels, including live Europe PMC and Crossref retrieval and the timeout path
